Addressed in patchset 19.
why we resetting actual error code returned from restartService() ?

Error code returned by `restartService` utility API is logged in 212.

If `restartService` has failed, we check if the inventory manager service is running and indicate the same information to the caller of `restartService()`
Acknowledged
why we need to check this, if l_errCode is SERVICE_RUNNING still restarting the service has been failed .

If `l_errCode` is `SERVICE_RUNNING`, it implies re-starting the inventory manager service has failed, but the inventory manager service is running and has "stale" data, so we need to trigger FRU VPD collection.

If `l_errCode` is `SERVICE_NOT_RUNNING`, it implies inventory manager service is not running and it is a critical scenario, so we want to fail `wait-vpd-parsers.service`
Done
